Description: Rules state Sticky and Raining Wilds carry x2 or x3 only. Math FG1 weights x1:1000/x2:500/x3:189 and FG2 x1:8/x2:2/x3:1 (Buy FG2 875/200/100) include x1, which is the most likely value.
Game Rules Reference: Sticky/Raining sections: 'random multiplier of x2 or x3'
Math File Reference: FG1 Calc Z3:AA5; FG2 Calc Z3:AA5; Buy FG2 Calc Z3:AA5
Impact: Misleading player information; certification failure; RTP described incorrectly
Linked Test Cases: PS-MTH-031, PS-MTH-033, PS-MTH-034, PS-MTH-035, PS-FEA-027, PS-FEA-037
Recommendation: Update rules to 'x1, x2 or x3' (or remove x1 from math and re-certify).

Description: Math defines Wild (WC) in base game on reels 2-5 with x1/x2/x3 multiplier (weights 10/5/2). Rules do not describe the Wild symbol, what it substitutes for (incl. Bonus), its reels or base game multipliers.

Linked Test Cases: PS-FUN-045, PS-FUN-046, PS-FUN-047, PS-FUN-048, PS-FUN-049, PS-MTH-027, PS-MTH-028, PS-MTH-029, PS-MTH-030, PS-MTH-031, PS-MTH-032

Description: Rules use payline terminology ('active payline', 'Only the highest win on each active payline is paid') for a Megaways ways game. Rules do not explain that wins are multiplied by the number of ways (product of symbol counts per reel).
Math File Reference: BG Calc hits = product of per-reel counts
Recommendation: Replace payline wording with ways wording; add ways calculation and 'highest win per symbol per way'.
